name: Kinder Pingui: Fresh Adventures
storyline: Pingui and Milch-Schnitte must go and defeat the evil baddies in this side-scrolling, action packed, 2D adventure!
summary: Fresh Adventures Collection is a compilation of the four Fresh Adventures platform games on a single disc: La Giungla Tenebrosa, La Montagna Misteriosa, La Fabbrica Spaziale, and La Valle Magica. Each is a 2D side-scrolling level in which Pinguì the penguin and Fetta al Latte, characters from Kinder's line of chilled snacks, recover the ingredients of a stolen recipe and then face a boss. All four worlds can be selected from the title screen, and each keeps its own high-score table.
